item.title: Rallying Cry – November 28, 2026
item.description: Perth is building safe homes for women and children fleeing domestic violence, while an 11-year-old poop-sniffing dog named Eba is helping protect endangered orcas, and London’s Darjeeling Express celebrates immigrant women reshaping the culinary scene.
